instruction: A candid outdoor medium shot of three children posing in a sunny park. In the center, the boy in a blue denim shirt (R5) has his arms around the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan and rust-colored dress (R3) on the left and the girl with bangs in a dark blue cardigan (R4) on the right. All three children lean in slightly and smile cheerfully at the camera. The background shows green park trees under bright, warm daylight with soft backlighting and a shallow depth of field.
